clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 特朗普：捐赠者助力儿童账户

subtitles.en: On Saturday, July 4th, our administration deposited one-time seed contributions of $1,000 each
subtitles.zh: 7月4日周六，政府向超过50万美国儿童的特朗普账户存入每人1000美元的一次性种子资金。

subtitles.en: into the Trump accounts of over 500,000 American children. It's a lot. And millions more will be
subtitles.zh: 这数量很大，还有数百万儿童将从迈克尔和苏珊·戴尔等慷慨捐赠者那里获得更多捐款。

subtitles.en: getting additional contributions from generous donors like, as I mentioned, Michael and Susan Dell. They are truly incredible. Go out and buy a Dell computer. He's not doing it for that.
subtitles.zh: 他们非常了不起，去戴尔买台电脑吧——他可不是为了这个才捐的，但我打赌他的生意更大了。

subtitles.en: But I'll bet his business, Brad, has gotten even bigger. I have a son that loves their laptop.
subtitles.zh: 我儿子就喜欢他们的笔记本，他们得说我要戴尔，我们总得把钱赚回来。

subtitles.en: They have to tell you, no, I want a Dell. We're going to get him that money back one way or the other.
subtitles.zh: 然后我再要600亿到500亿，重新开始整个过程。

subtitles.en: And then I'll ask for another $6 billion to 50. We'll start the whole process all over again.
subtitles.zh: 不，他一开始就做出了不可思议的产品，布拉德·格斯特纳一直在推动这事。

subtitles.en: No, he makes an incredible product and right from the beginning. And Brad Gerstner has been pushing this. So he's a very successful man. Not quite as famous as the Dell family, right? It's Michael,
subtitles.zh: 他非常成功，虽不如戴尔家族出名，但投入了巨额资金。

subtitles.en: but he's an amazingly successful guy. And he's put up a tremendous amount of money. And again, I want to thank Michael and all of the companies that have already called me and they're putting up
subtitles.zh: 我要感谢迈克尔和所有已联系我的公司，他们投入了很多钱。

subtitles.en: a lot of money. This is nothing. This is not me. And put the name on. It was not my idea. That was a whole group of people that passed legislation because this is all made possible only by the passage
subtitles.zh: 这不是我的主意，是一群人通过了法案，这一切才成为可能。

subtitles.en: of the Great Big Beautiful Bill. And I knew that this was happening, but I didn't know.
subtitles.zh: 我知道这事会发生，但之前并不知情。
